candidate_reports.remark: Tree down over roadway. Delayed report. Time estimated from radar.
Reports of trees down in Adairville by dispatch.
Reports of trees down in Lewisburg from dispatch.
Tree down that had to be removed from Rochester Road. Morgantown Dispatch. Time estimated from radar. Call came in 20 minutes later.
Numerous trees downed in Cromwell and Prentiss. Delayed report. Time estimated from radar.
Numerous trees downed by thunderstorm winds. Delayed report. Time estimated from radar.
Crop damage and structural damage to a barn occurred off Roy Bagby Road_ and at points along Highway 218 to the east.
Broadcast media relayed a video of flooded roads at the intersection of Patti Lane and Taylorsville Road.
Cars stuck in the water on N. Hurstborne just north of Six Mile Lane. Jefferstown Fire responding to water rescues at this location.
Report of a water rescue for a vehicle stuck in the water. Seneca Trail and Southside Drive.
